class.name: WorldSnow
class.brief_description: The snow contract: the snowpack and lake ice at a point, for any system (vehicle grip, plants, footsteps).
class.description: Read it through [method WorldContracts.get_snow]. [SnowCover3D] produces it; with no snow system every reading is bare ground. A test sets a stub (a script extending this class) with [method WorldContracts.set_snow]; methods it does not override still come from the snow cover.

method.name: add_impurity
method.description: Light-absorbing particles (soot, ash, dust) settling on the snow within [param radius] of [param position], as mg/m2 of black carbon equivalent; mineral dust counts about 0.013 of its mass. The snow darkens and melts sooner.

method.name: avalanche_peak_pressure_at
method.description: The highest avalanche impact pressure put at [param position] so far (Pa). Default 0.

method.name: avalanche_pressure_at
method.description: Avalanche impact pressure at [param position] now (Pa): the dense flow where it runs, else the powder cloud. Default 0.

method.name: canopy_capacity_at
method.description: The most new snow the tree canopy over [param position] can hold (kg per m2 of ground; Hedstrom and Pomeroy 1998). Default 0.

method.name: canopy_load_at
method.description: Snow held in the tree crowns over [param position] (kg per m2 of ground). Default 0.

method.name: crust_at
method.description: Returns the load a crust in the pack bears before a foot breaks through, in kPa; 0 with none.

method.name: density_at
method.description: Returns the pack's bulk density at [param position] in kg/m³: about 100 for new powder, 250 to 350 settled, 400 to 550 old or wet; 0 where bare.

method.name: depth_at
method.description: Returns the snow on the ground at [param position] in metres, 0 with no snow system.

method.name: has_provider
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a snow cover is in the tree.

method.name: impurity_at
method.description: Light-absorbing particles showing at the snow's surface at [param position], mg/m2 of black carbon equivalent (those buried under fresh snow show less). Default 0.

method.name: lake_ice_at
method.description: Returns the lake ice at [param position] as (thickness in metres, the share of it that is white snow ice). Ice of 5 cm and more bears a walker.

method.name: shake_canopy
method.description: A crown shaken from outside the weather (a stem snapping, a tree felled, a body brushing it): [param share] (0 to 1) of the snow held within [param radius] of [param position] falls onto the pack below as fresh snow, keeping its mass. Returns the kg moved. Default: no-op, 0.

method.name: surface_at
method.description: Returns the snow surface height in metres, with the prints near the camera; [code]-INF[/code] where there is no snow.

method.name: wetness_at
method.description: Returns the liquid water in the pack over what it can hold, 0 (dry) to 1 (slush).
